prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional text to provide as a prompt for each Whisper model call.

mask_only.title: Mask Only
mask_only.description: If True, the output will only include mask.

mask_limit.title: Mask Limit
mask_limit.description: maximum number of masks to return. If -1 or None, all masks will be returned. NOTE: The masks are sorted by predicted_iou.

crop_n_layers.title: Crop N Layers
crop_n_layers.description: If >0, mask prediction will be run again on crops of the image. Sets the number of layers to run, where each layer has 2**i_layer number of image crops

box_nms_thresh.title: Box Nms Thresh
box_nms_thresh.description: The box IoU cutoff used by non-maximal suppression to filter duplicate masks.

crop_nms_thresh.title: Crop Nms Thresh
crop_nms_thresh.description: The box IoU cutoff used by non-maximal suppression to filter duplicate masks between different crops.

points_per_side.title: Points Per Side
points_per_side.description: The number of points to be sampled along one side of the image. The total number of points is points_per_side**2. If None, point_grids must provide explicit point sampling.

pred_iou_thresh.title: Pred Iou Thresh
pred_iou_thresh.description: A filtering threshold in [0,1], using the model's predicted mask quality.

crop_overlap_ratio.title: Crop Overlap Ratio
crop_overlap_ratio.description: Sets the degree to which crops overlap. In the first crop layer, crops will overlap by this fraction of the image length. Later layers with more crops scale down this overlap.

min_mask_region_area.title: Min Mask Region Area
min_mask_region_area.description: If >0, postprocessing will be applied to remove disconnected regions and holes in masks with area smaller than min_mask_region_area.

stability_score_offset.title: Stability Score Offset
stability_score_offset.description: The amount to shift the cutoff when calculated the stability score.

stability_score_thresh.title: Stability Score Thresh
stability_score_thresh.description: A filtering threshold in [0,1], using the stability of the mask under changes to the cutoff used to binarize the model's mask predictions.

crop_n_points_downscale_factor.title: Crop N Points Downscale Factor
crop_n_points_downscale_factor.description: The number of points-per-side sampled in layer n is scaled down by crop_n_points_downscale_factor**n.
